params.name: query
params.description: Literal word search (non-semantic). Finds messages containing these EXACT words in any order. Use single words users actually type, not concepts or phrases. Example: use "dinner" not "dinner plans", use "sick" not "health issues". If omitted, returns results filtered only by other parameters.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque pagination cursor; do not inspect. Use together with 'direction'.

params.name: direction
params.description: Pagination direction used with 'cursor': 'before' fetches older results, 'after' fetches newer results. Defaults to 'before' when only 'cursor' is provided.

params.name: chatIDs
params.description: Limit search to specific chat IDs.

params.name: accountIDs
params.description: Limit search to specific account IDs.

params.name: chatType
params.description: Filter by chat type: 'group' for group chats, 'single' for 1:1 chats.

params.name: mediaTypes
params.description: Filter messages by media types. Use ['any'] for any media type, or specify exact types like ['video', 'image']. Omit for no media filtering.

params.name: sender
params.description: Filter by sender: 'me' (messages sent by the authenticated user), 'others' (messages sent by others), or a specific user ID string (user.id).

params.name: dateAfter
params.description: Only include messages with timestamp strictly after this ISO 8601 datetime (e.g., '2024-07-01T00:00:00Z' or '2024-07-01T00:00:00+02:00').

params.name: dateBefore
params.description: Only include messages with timestamp strictly before this ISO 8601 datetime (e.g., '2024-07-31T23:59:59Z' or '2024-07-31T23:59:59+02:00').

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of messages to return.

params.name: excludeLowPriority
params.description: Exclude messages marked Low Priority by the user. Default: true. Set to false to include all.

params.name: includeMuted
params.description: Include messages in chats marked as Muted by the user, which are usually less important. Default: true. Set to false if the user wants a more refined search.
